catalogue.family_purpose: Measure staged active workloads and native behavior separately from natural journeys.

description: Manufactured four-site performance test from the McWilliams extortion save at turn 5241593. Player 140,39; bandit camp 140,51; cannibal camps 150,39, 130,39 and 140,29. Four bandits and three cannibal pairs are prepared at their homes; all 16 inherited human bodies are preserved. An earlier native run measured 1,799 turns and reloaded the saved result; a later saved-start comparison found all ten selected bodies displaced. This does not qualify the current build or prove scaling or gain. The 05c67 ownership rejection was from the old fixture.

evidence_contract.claim: Four human parties can earn simultaneous physical work and a useful measured load interval, then preserve their actual progress through same-result reload. Native qualification remains required.
evidence_contract.setup_label: Manufactured four-camp ownership, home positions and current reservations; setup has no gameplay credit.
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for four-party work or measured performance
evidence_contract.failure_rule: All four physical-body/report/claim preflights abort before live input on failure. Require actual body and owner progress for each party plus a retained same-run measurement interval; labels or unchanged transition timestamps alone do not establish work. Preserve genuine refusals, casualties and missing measurements. Reentry must use the same saved result without fixture reinstall.

steps.label: four_site_physical_work_and_reload
steps.objective:
Preparation: fresh manufactured CLOSE metrics control, not a representative remote story. Origin is the maintained McWilliams extortion save (turn5241593, calendar4752000), preserving all sixteen native NPC bodies, player kit and saved zones. Player starts at OMT140,39. Home footprints are bandit140..141,51..52 and cannibal150..151,39..40 /130..131,39..40 /140..141,29..30. Four bandits IDs4-7 and cannibal pairs8-9,10-11,12-13 are selected; remaining bodies are conserved. Camps hold current abstract outbound shakedown/toll or raid/raid reservations, with distinct report/claim tuples and zero-credit clock adoption. All bodies initially stand at their own home tiles, with no projection leases. Prepared camp supplies are seven units per member; no fire, signal, zones, new NPCs or completed journey is supplied.

After World, all four aborting physical-body/owner/claim audits must pass. Confirm AUTOSAVE=false and RAID_PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTIC=normal. Use only the selected compatible source-bound product and advertised native controls. Observe actual body poses/goals/routes and eligibility before counting simultaneous work; labels and transition timestamps alone prove neither travel nor rejection. Native active_sites/job_mix omit hostile reservations, so those legacy counters cannot certify this workload.

Follow a useful guard-sized window, targeting30game-minutes when survival and ownership permit, and retain original performance interval plus actual ten-body/four-owner progress. Handle genuine danger normally; preserve the first concrete refusal instead of repeating an unchanged wait or repairing saved state. No post-load NPC/lease/clock/report edits. Save and close normally, then supported SAME-result reentry without fixture reinstall, proving identity/body/owner/clock continuity. Initial guards and component tests do not prove gameplay, measured load or gain. Existing canonical mixed1800 proof and historical05c67 failure remain separate.
